name: yatsude
description: yatsude (eight hands): a composable framework for AI-driven everyday work, plus a flow map pane, as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: yatsude
plugins.description: More arms for your everyday work: coding agents work the daily loops (bug queue, MR reviews, backlog, the night shift) and stop for you on the calls. Small units, chained into flows, under a permission charter.

plugins.name: flow-map
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat with the flows and units your skills offer, each with a one-line summary. Click one to put it in the prompt. Works with any skill collection that lists its units under a flow's ## Units.
